newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 1.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 1.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
** Indonesia is expected to suffer a $700 million balance of payments deficit in 1997, after enjoying a projected $200 million surplus this year, a domestic think tank said.
** The Dow Jones industrial average ended up 36.15 points at 6,029.38 on Thursday as the prices of oil and other commodities fell and weak economic data suggested interest rates will remain low.

** The Jakarta Composite Index fell 0.83 points, or 0.15 percent, to close at 568.03 points Jakarta on Thursday as many players were focusing on the year's largest public offer on Monday, a partial float of state-owned Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI), brokers said.
** On Friday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,329.20/29.50 in early trading against an opening of 2,328.50/29.50.
** Indonesia's largest cocoa producer Davomas Abadi on reports it had secured a 10-year contract to sell 40,000 tonnes of cocoa powder and butter per year to a foreign firm.
** Bank Niaga on the announcement of a rise in its 1996 nine month net profit compared to the same period last year.
** H.M. Sampoerna on reports the capital market supervisory agency had confirmed its founder and president director Putra Sampoerna had a 15 percent stake in automobile conglomerate Astra.
** Textile firm Pan Brothers Tex on reports of a plan to divest stakes in private-owned firms PT Pancaplaza Indotextile, PT Charpan Buana and PT Pancaprima Ekabrothers.
** Property firm Suryamas Duta Makmur on market talk of a possible rights issue.
